name: alexandria
description: Search and retrieve from the Alexandria knowledge store hosted on suki.
long_description: Bridges Claude Desktop to the remote Alexandria MCP server (streamable HTTP) running on suki over Tailscale. Because Claude Desktop config only speaks stdio and Alexandria authenticates with a static bearer token over plain HTTP (no OAuth, no TLS), this extension runs mcp-remote under Claude Desktop's bundled Node to proxy stdio <-> the remote endpoint. The bearer token is stored securely and injected via an environment variable.

token.title: Auth token
token.description: Alexandria MCP bearer token (contents of ~/.local/share/alexandria/auth_token on suki)
